name: defi_tvl_cross_momentum_breadth_full_universe
rationale: Thesis: a TVL up-cross is a market-wide DeFi liquidity event that should lift the whole crypto complex, so we enter ANY universe asset whose own momentum is positive at the moment the macro TVL cross fires — confluence of macro capital inflow with per-asset trend. Disconfirmer: gate the per-asset momentum filter alone (ret_Nd gt, no TVL) over the same window; if breadth-of-momentum already captures the return, the macro TVL confirm is redundant, and compare to per-asset buy-and-hold to rule out pure beta.
catalyst: market-wide defi_tvl up-cross coincides with positive per-asset momentum
